1. [DATASET SELECTION] Load three datasets via RecSysDataSet.use_dataloader() using the correct DataSet enum values: DataSet.MovieLens100K, DataSet.Amazon2014VideoGames, and DataSet.HetrecLastFM.
2. [PREPROCESSING - MAKE IMPLICIT] Apply MakeImplicit(3) to MovieLens100K and Amazon2014VideoGames (but NOT HetrecLastFM, which is already implicit) to convert ratings > 3 to implicit feedback.
3. [PREPROCESSING - CORE PRUNING] Apply CorePruning(5) to all three datasets for 5-core filtering on users and items.
4. [PREPROCESSING ORDER] The preprocessing pipeline must apply MakeImplicit before CorePruning for MovieLens100K and Amazon2014VideoGames.

5. [DATA SPLITTING - 5 SEEDS] For each of 5 explicitly defined random seeds, apply UserHoldout with test_size=0.2 (80/20 user-based holdout). Before each split, call set_random_state(seed) to ensure reproducibility. Note: UserHoldout requires both validation_size and test_size parameters; use validation_size=0.0 as it is not needed for this experiment.

6. [ALGORITHM CONFIGURATION] Configure three algorithms via ExperimentPlan: LensKit.PopScorer (popularity baseline), LensKit.ItemKNNScorer (item-based kNN), and LensKit.ImplicitMFScorer (ALS-based matrix factorization). All three must use default hyperparameters with feedback='implicit'.

7. [EXPERIMENT DESIGN - FULL FACTORIAL] Execute a full factorial design: 3 datasets × 3 algorithms × 5 random seeds = 45 independent runs, where each (dataset, algorithm, seed) combination is evaluated separately.
8. [EVALUATION METRICS] Evaluate using Evaluator with NDCG(k) and Precision(k) ranking metrics for k=[1, 5, 10] on the test split.
9. [EXPERIMENT EXECUTION] Execute all experiments using run_omnirec() with the preprocessed datasets, ExperimentPlan, and Evaluator.

10. [STATISTICAL ANALYSIS] For each (dataset, algorithm, k) combination, report the mean and standard deviation of NDCG@k and Precision@k across the 5 seeds to quantify the impact of data split randomness.
11. [REPRODUCIBILITY] Explicitly define and document the 5 random seed values used, and call set_random_state() before each data split operation.
